name: Cartographer's Eye
effect: You can draw an accurate map of ground you have crossed. +2 dice on Wits + Insight to navigate terrain you have travelled before.
description: You can draw an accurate map of ground you have crossed. +2 dice on Wits + Insight to navigate terrain you have travelled before. From the Book of Talents (Talents and Special Abilities).
